name: tool
definition: A reusable aid or instrument the team uses to perform recurring work consistently.

name: check
definition: A verification step that confirms required conditions, quality, or completeness before proceeding.

name: gate
definition: A mandatory decision point that allows work to continue only when specified criteria are met.

name: harness
definition: A guiding structure that constrains or supports how work is performed to prevent drift or harm.

name: retrieval
definition: A stored way to locate relevant prior knowledge when it is needed.

name: judgment
definition: A home for guidance on making decisions that depend on context, interpretation, or discretion.
